Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =\frac{4}{5},$ calculate the area (in square units) of $△ABC$ shown above.
question.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot AC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta =\frac{4}{5},$ where $\theta =m∠B.$ Notice we're also given the length of the side $\overset{―}{AB}$ adjacent to $∠B.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to find the length of the opposite side $\overset{―}{AC}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡\theta  & =\frac{AC}{AB} \\ \frac{4}{5} & =\frac{AC}{10} \\ AC & =\frac{4}{5}\cdot 10 \\ AC & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot AC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 10\cdot 8 \\  & =40.\end{aligned}
$$
